events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired COCO MADEMOISELLE fragrance experience for the launch of CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, hair and body products, makeup and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the experience is free. Appointments are available, but CHANEL explicitly says walk-ins are encouraged during event hours.
events.caveats: Appointments are limited, but CHANEL's official event page says walk-ins are encouraged. Merchandise can be purchased onsite; purchase is not required for public access.
events.practical_notes: September 11 and 18 run noon–7 PM. September 12–13 and 19–20 run 10 AM–7 PM.

events.what_it_is: A NYFW pop-up styled like a New York stoop with hair and makeup refreshes, a photo booth, legwear, customization and coffee.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touchups and the photo booth are advertised as free. Embroidery terms vary by source and may require purchase of knee highs, so it is not represented as universally free.
events.caveats: Current event listings agree the pop-up is open to the public September 12–13 from noon–5 PM. Merchandise is sold onsite, and embroidery terms conflict across secondary listings, so only consistently supported freebies are stated.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public pop-up. No RSVP, ticket or organizer-approval requirement is published in the current listings.

events.address: Dante West Village, 551 Hudson St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public fragrance-launch activation for The Manoeuvres of The Baroness with chess, fragrance discovery, signature beverages and pastries at Dante West Village.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the September 10 activation is free. The verified listings describe the fragrance, chess experience, beverages and treats as part of the activation; the separate Baroness mocktail offered September 10–13 to Dante customers is a purchasable item.
events.caveats: Two current event listings independently describe the September 10 activation as open to the public. No advance RSVP requirement is stated. The separate signature mocktail available through September 13 is for purchase and should not be confused with free admission.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 10 from 2–6 PM at Dante West Village.

events.address: This is Latin America, 234 Grand St, Brooklyn, NY 11211
events.what_it_is: A multi-day trunk show featuring emerging-market fashion brands and a curated Onata Haus assortment, with public shopping hours and a Saturday charm-bar program.
events.what_is_free: General public access during the published open hours is free. Merchandise is for sale; Friday also includes private styling by appointment.
events.caveats: The host page explicitly says the event is open to the public Friday 11 AM–5 PM, Saturday 11 AM–7 PM and Sunday 11 AM–2 PM. The Luma page offers registration, but it does not state that registration is required or subject to host approval for those public hours.
events.practical_notes: Public hours differ by date. Friday private styling is separately available by appointment; Saturday includes a charm bar from 11 AM–2 PM.
